decisions.executionNote: Orient left gripper for the leftmost ring, using small continuous elbow-up motion; right arm stays still.
Finish the downward grasp orientation and descend to the leftmost ring; verify alignment before closing.
Close on the aligned ring and lift vertically, checking retention from the cameras.
Transport the visibly retained ring toward the far-left board cell, staying above the board.
Align over the far-left cell and lower the held ring to board height.
Release the first ring in the far-left cell, lift clear and begin retreat toward the waiting pose.
Return left arm to the waiting pose after the visible first placement; then remain still for the opponent.
Opponent has begun its turn; hold both arms motionless at the current observed poses.
Wait without arm motion while the opponent picks its mark.
Keep both arms still through the opponent's turn.
Remain motionless while the opponent transports its mark.
Wait motionless while the opponent lowers its cross onto the board.
Keep both arms still until the opponent has fully retreated.
Wait for the opponent to finish returning home; no policy arm motion.
Opponent is home. Approach the next left-side ring from above with the left arm.
Lower onto the next ring and close the left gripper; retention will be checked during lift.
Lift the second ring with gripper closed, then move toward the empty near-left cell.
Align the retained second ring over the near-left cell and lower it to board height.
Release the second ring, lift clear of the board, and retreat left to give the opponent room.
Finish retreating to the left waiting area and stop, leaving the board clear for the opponent.
Settle closer to the waiting posture with small increments, then hold still for the opponent.
Opponent is moving; hold both policy arms still.
Remain still during the opponent's pickup.
Hold both arms stationary while the opponent carries its second cross.
Wait motionless while the opponent places its second cross.
Hold both arms still during the opponent's placement and retreat.
Remain motionless until the opponent finishes its retreat.
Keep both arms still while the opponent completes its return home.
Opponent is home. Approach the center supply ring with the left arm from above, preserving elbow-up continuity.
Align the left gripper over the center supply ring and descend to grasp height.
Close on the center supply ring, lift it, and begin moving toward the empty middle-left board cell.
Carry the visibly held third ring to the middle-left cell and lower it gently to board height.
Set down and release the third ring in the middle-left cell, lift clear, then retreat from the board.
Return to the left waiting area after the third visible placement, with a margin from the fully straight configuration.
Opponent has started its third turn; hold both arms still.
Hold both arms motionless during the opponent's pickup.
Remain motionless while the opponent lifts and transports its third cross.
Hold both arms still throughout the opponent's third turn.
Wait without policy arm motion as the opponent places its cross.
Keep both arms stationary until the opponent has finished retreating.
Wait stationary for the opponent to complete its return to the home pose.
Opponent is back home. Orient the right gripper to pick the nearer right-side supply ring; left arm stays in its waiting area.
Align and lower the right gripper onto the inner of the two remaining supply rings.
Close the right gripper on the fourth ring, lift, and begin carrying it toward the empty near-right cell.
Carry the retained fourth ring above the near-right cell and lower it to the board.
Set down and release the fourth ring, lift clear, and retreat to the right away from the board.
Return the right arm to its waiting area with the gripper open, preserving a slight elbow bend.
Opponent has started its final turn; keep both policy arms motionless.
Keep both arms still during the opponent's final pickup.
Wait motionless while the opponent lifts its last cross.
Hold both arms stationary while the opponent carries its final cross toward the board.
Remain motionless while the opponent lowers its final cross.
Hold both arms still while the opponent releases its last cross and retreats.
Remain still until the opponent has fully returned home.
Allow the opponent to finish settling at home before starting the final placement.
Opponent is home. Orient the right gripper above the last ring, keeping the left arm stationary.
Lower onto the final ring and close the right gripper; check retention during the next lift.
Lift the last ring and carry it toward the only empty cell, the near-center cell, with the right gripper closed.
Align the retained final ring over the near-center cell and lower it to board height.
Release the fifth ring in the near-center cell, lift clear, and begin retreating with the gripper open.
